en.summary: Fixes multi-bank XRT AFU memory addressing so each bank contributes its bank offset exactly once instead of aliasing banks onto the same address range.
why_it_counts: The hardware fix is in the AFU wrapper address path that drives external AXI memory banks.
xrtsim is updated to match the corrected bank-offset placement.
The subject explicitly says these are AFU bug fixes.
disqualifiers: The commit also includes XRT packaging and script changes.
evidence: VX_afu_wrap.sv adds a BANK_OFFSET term inside the per-bank address loop for both AW and AR.
sim/xrtsim/xrt_sim.cpp removes the extra i * mem_bank_size_ offset from both read and write requests.
The diff is focused on physical address formation.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: In a multi-bank memory interface, bank identity must appear in the physical address map exactly once. If the wrapper fails to add the per-bank base offset, or hardware and model disagree about which side adds it, different banks can alias the same physical region.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: The design runs with more than one external memory bank and bank-local addresses must be translated into bank-qualified physical addresses.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Remove the bank-dependent base offset from the hardware address formula, or equivalently add the bank contribution on the wrong side of the interface.
portability_notes: Apply this to any AFU, DMA, cache, or memory wrapper with one channel per physical bank.
The reusable bug is incorrect placement of bank-select bits or bank base offset in the external address map.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the logic that converts each bank local address into an outgoing physical byte address.
Delete the bank-select or bank-offset contribution from that formula.
Run a multi-bank workload that touches disjoint bank ranges to expose aliasing or wrong-bank access.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: per-bank AXI address generation in the XRT AFU wrapper
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix adds a per-bank BANK_OFFSET to AXI AW and AR addresses in hardware and removes duplicate bank offseting in xrtsim.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Remove the BANK_OFFSET contribution from m_axi_mem_awaddr_a and m_axi_mem_araddr_a; optionally restore the old extra bank offset in xrtsim.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Different memory banks can alias the same physical address range or access the wrong bank, causing wrong-bank reads, writes, or silent data corruption.
evidence_for_injection: The only DUT-facing hunk adds a per-bank offset in the wrapper g_addressing block.
The simulator side removes a second bank offset at the same time.
Both read and write paths are corrected.
notes: This is a reusable address-generation fault for banked off-chip memory interfaces.
If hardware-only injection is preferred, mutating the wrapper is sufficient.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了多 bank XRT AFU 的内存寻址问题，使每个 bank 的偏移只被应用一次，而不会让多个 bank 映射到同一地址区间。
why_it_counts: 硬件修复点位于 AFU wrapper 驱动外部 AXI memory bank 的地址路径。
xrtsim 也同步更新，以匹配修正后的 bank offset 放置方式。
提交标题明确说明这是 AFU bug fixes。
disqualifiers: 该提交还包含 XRT 打包和脚本调整。
evidence: VX_afu_wrap.sv 在按 bank 的地址循环中为 AW 和 AR 都加入了 BANK_OFFSET。
sim/xrtsim/xrt_sim.cpp 从读写请求里都删除了额外的 i * mem_bank_size_ 偏移。
补丁聚焦于物理地址形成。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 在多 bank 内存接口中，bank 身份在物理地址图中必须且只能出现一次。如果 wrapper 漏掉每 bank 的基址偏移，或者硬件和模型对偏移应该由哪一侧添加理解不一致，不同 bank 就可能映射到同一物理区间。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 按 bank 的外部内存地址生成
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 设计启用了多个外部 memory bank，且 bank-local 地址必须被转换成带 bank 身份的物理地址。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 从硬件地址公式中删除每 bank 的基址偏移，或者等价地在接口错误的一侧保留 bank 偏移。
portability_notes: 适用于任何为每个物理 bank 提供一条 channel 的 AFU、DMA、cache 或 memory wrapper。
可复用缺陷的本质是外部地址图中的 bank-select 位或基址偏移放置错误。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到把每个 bank 的本地地址转换成外部物理字节地址的逻辑。
删除该公式中的 bank-select 或 bank-offset 项。
运行会访问不同 bank 区间的多 bank 负载，以暴露地址别名或错误 bank 访问。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: XRT AFU wrapper 中按 bank 生成 AXI 地址的逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复在硬件 AXI AW 和 AR 地址中加入每 bank 的 BANK_OFFSET，并在 xrtsim 中去掉重复的 bank offset。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 从 m_axi_mem_awaddr_a 和 m_axi_mem_araddr_a 的公式中删除 BANK_OFFSET；如需匹配原 bug，也可在 xrtsim 中恢复旧的额外 bank 偏移。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 不同 memory bank 可能映射到同一物理地址区间，或者访问到错误的 bank，从而导致错误读写或静默数据损坏。
evidence_for_injection: 唯一的 DUT 侧逻辑改动就是在 wrapper 的 g_addressing 块中加入每 bank 偏移。
模型侧同步删除了第二次 bank 偏移。
读路径和写路径都被同时修正。
notes: 这是适用于 banked off-chip memory interface 的可复用地址生成故障。
如果偏好只做硬件注入，修改 wrapper 即可。
